result.requirement: The system shall validate customer identity and contact details during the onboarding process to ensure compliance and secure account creation.
result.business_need: The business needs to verify customer identity to prevent fraud, ensure accurate delivery routing, and maintain regulatory compliance before allowing order placement.
functional_behaviour: The system shall collect unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods from the Customer during onboarding.
The system shall verify the authenticity of the provided identity documents against a trusted data source.
The system shall validate that the contact details match the provided identity information.
The system shall block account activation if identity verification fails or contact details are inconsistent.
The system shall generate a Verified Customer Profile upon successful validation.
The system shall log all verification attempts and outcomes for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: Unique identifiers for the ordering individual
Delivery addresses and primary contact methods
business_rules: A Customer Profile cannot be activated until identity verification is successful.
Contact details must match the name and address on the verified identity document.
Any failed verification attempt must generate a Dispute Ticket for manual review.
The system must flag accounts with inconsistent contact details for further investigation.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer submits valid identity documents and matching contact details
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the onboarding request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system activates the Customer Profile and allows order placement

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer submits mismatched contact details or invalid identity documents
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the onboarding request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the request and creates a Dispute Ticket for review
